title: Set the Sample Clock
story: The toy waveform must scroll against an exact millisecond clock.
lesson: A sample rate in Hz counts samples per second. Milliseconds per sample are 1000 / rate. Avoid repeated addition drift by multiplying the index.
objective: Return n timestamps i*1000/rate_hz, starting at 0. Return [] when n<=0 or rate_hz<=0.
hint: Validate the rate before dividing. Compute each sample time from its index.
